phase_layout: code[:2]=character of s=a+b, code[2:4]=character of a
normalization: unit l2 norm in each phase pair; global covariance 0.5 I_4
phase_decoder: complex product of first four code coordinates with train-fitted single complex offset
readout_training: 480 shear labels for offset and affine ridge; 481 held-out pair labels for evaluation
compute: single CPU thread, 2 seeds, all fixed settings, no external model
